need: Apply a substantial additive GitHub List projection without making an eventually consistent full-account read after every membership write.

queries: live updateUserListsForItem response identity and complete lists payload
live UserList items read-after-write behavior during a 242-membership projection
existing ShouldaUsedThat apply receipts, drift checks, and independent verification
discovery.stop_condition: The live run reproduced stale immediate List reads, while the mutation returned the exact repository identity and complete resulting List-ID set needed for a deterministic acknowledgement.

contenders.name: validated mutation response plus mandatory final full replay
evidence: GitHub echoes the client mutation ID and repository identity
the response includes the complete resulting List-ID set
the adapter already rejects any response that differs from the requested union
a fresh full Star-and-List replay and an independent verify still gate success

contenders.name: full account read after every membership mutation
evidence: repeated Star pagination contributes no membership-union evidence
immediate List reads were observably eventually consistent
the live run stopped on a stale read despite an exact successful mutation response

contenders.name: blind batch writes with no per-operation receipt or final replay
evidence: would treat transport success as verification

hard_gates: current plus target List union is computed before every membership write
the mutation must echo the exact client mutation ID and repository node ID
the complete returned List-ID set must equal the requested union
no observed membership may be omitted from the union
one immutable receipt remains bound to every sealed operation
a fresh complete remote replay must satisfy the plan before apply is complete
independent verify must still reconstruct all postconditions
unknowns: GitHub Lists remain a preview surface with unspecified consistency timing.
Concurrent manual membership edits inside the read-to-write window remain external drift and should be avoided during apply.
A future dedicated Lists API may offer an atomic add-only operation that removes the set-union race entirely.
decision_effect: Treat GitHub's strictly validated mutation payload as the immediate acknowledgement, materialize only that additive union in local progress state, retain exact operation receipts, and require full remote replay before complete apply and again during verify.
reconsider_when: GitHub removes the complete lists payload from the mutation
the response no longer reflects the committed membership set
a dedicated atomic add-only membership API becomes available
final replay or independent verification exposes a mismatch
